items.stem: A bag contains 3 red marbles, 5 blue marbles, and 2 green marbles. If one marble is chosen at random, what is the probability that it is blue?
items.explanation: Синих 5 из 10: 5/10 = 1/2 (C). 5/7 — поделили на 7 вместо 10; 3/10 — вероятность красного; 1/5 — зелёного.

items.stem: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is the probability of rolling a number greater than 4?
items.explanation: Подходят 5 и 6 — 2 исхода из 6: 2/6 = 1/3.

items.stem: A spinner is divided into 8 equal sections numbered 1 through 8. What is the probability that the spinner lands on an even number?
items.explanation: Чётные 2, 4, 6, 8 — 4 из 8: 1/2 (C). 1/8 — один сектор; 1/4 — два сектора; 3/4 — шесть.

items.stem: A fair coin is flipped twice. What is the probability that both flips land heads?
items.explanation: Исходы ОО, ОР, РО, РР — один из четырёх (C): 1/2 · 1/2 = 1/4. 1/3 — считали «0, 1 или 2 орла» равновероятными; 1/8 — три броска.

items.stem: In a group of 40 students, 14 play soccer. If one student is chosen at random from the group, what is the probability that the student plays soccer?
items.explanation: Вероятность = благоприятные исходы / все исходы: 14 футболистов из 40 учеников, 14/40 = 7/20 = 0.35.

items.stem: Ten cards are numbered 1 through 10. If one card is drawn at random, what is the probability that its number is a multiple of 3?
items.explanation: Кратны 3: 3, 6, 9 — три карты из десяти (B). 1/3 — «каждое третье» без учёта, что 10 не делится на 3; 2/5 — ошибка в подсчёте.

items.stem: The probability that it will rain tomorrow is 0.3. What is the probability that it will not rain tomorrow?
items.explanation: Противоположные события дают в сумме 1: 1 − 0.3 = 0.7 (C). Вероятность не может быть больше 1 (D).

items.stem: A jar contains 6 lemon candies and some cherry candies and no other candies. If the probability of choosing a lemon candy at random is 1/4, how many cherry candies are in the jar?
items.explanation: 6 — это 1/4 всех конфет, значит всего 24; вишнёвых 24 − 6 = 18.

items.stem: The table shows how many students in two grades have a pet. If a student in grade 10 is chosen at random, what is the probability that the student has a pet?
items.explanation: Только 10-й класс: 10 из 20 — 1/2 (C). 1/5 — 10 из 50 всех учеников; 2/5 — данные 9-го класса; 11/25 — 22 из 50, по обоим классам.

items.stem: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. How many different outcomes are possible?
items.explanation: Каждому из 6 исходов первого кубика соответствуют 6 исходов второго: 36 (C). 12 — сложили; 64 — 8 · 8.

items.stem: A letter is chosen at random from the 6 letters of the word BANANA. What is the probability that the letter is A?
items.explanation: Букв A три из шести: 3/6 = 1/2.

items.stem: In a survey of 50 people, 25 said they prefer tea, 15 said they prefer coffee, and 10 said they prefer neither. Each person gave only one answer. If one of these people is chosen at random, what is the probability that the person prefers coffee?
items.explanation: 15 из 50 — 3/10 (A). 3/8 = 15/40 — забыли тех, кто не выбрал ничего; 15/35 — не учли 15 любителей чая в знаменателе; 1/3 — «один из трёх ответов».

items.stem: The probability that an item from a factory is defective is 0.02. How many defective items would be expected in a batch of 500 items?
items.explanation: Ожидаемое число = вероятность · количество = 0.02 · 500 = 10 (B). 2 — сама вероятность в процентах; 25 и 50 — ошибки с запятой.

items.stem: An integer is chosen at random from the integers 1 through 20. What is the probability that the integer is a prime number?
items.explanation: Простые числа: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 — 8 из 20, то есть 2/5. Единица не простое число.

items.stem: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. Which of the following events is least likely?
items.explanation: Вероятности: 1/6, 3/6, 4/6 и 1. Наименьшая — выпадение 6 (A); последнее событие достоверное.

items.stem: In a survey of 200 people, 120 were adults and 80 were children. Of the adults, 45 prefer the beach to the mountains; of the children, 50 prefer the beach. If a person who prefers the beach is chosen at random, what is the probability that the person is a child?
items.explanation: Условие — «любит пляж»: таких 95, из них дети 50, 50/95 = 10/19 (A). 5/8 = 50/80 — доля любителей пляжа среди детей (обратное условие); 1/4 = 50/200; 9/19 — взрослые.

items.stem: A bag contains 4 red marbles and 6 blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both marbles are red?
items.explanation: Первый красный 4/10, после этого второй красный 3/9: (4/10)(3/9) = 12/90 = 2/15. С возвращением было бы (4/10)² = 0.16.

items.stem: A fair six-sided die is rolled and a fair coin is flipped. What is the probability of rolling a 3 and flipping heads?
items.explanation: События независимы: 1/6 · 1/2 = 1/12 (A). 2/3 — сложили 1/6 и 1/2; 1/6 — забыли про монету.

items.stem: At a school, 60% of the students take chemistry, 40% take physics, and 25% take both. What is the probability that a randomly selected student takes chemistry or physics (or both)?
items.explanation: P(A или B) = 0.6 + 0.4 − 0.25 = 0.75 (B): пересечение посчитано дважды. 1 — забыли вычесть; 0.85 — вычли не то; 0.25 — только оба.

items.stem: The probability that a spinner lands on red is 0.35. If the spinner is spun 60 times, how many times would you expect it to land on red?
items.explanation: Ожидаемое число = вероятность · число попыток: 0.35 · 60 = 21 раз.

items.stem: The table shows whether 150 juniors and seniors play a musical instrument. If a senior is chosen at random, what is the probability that the senior plays an instrument?
items.explanation: Выпускников 75, из них играют 15: 15/75 = 1/5 (B). 1/10 = 15/150 — от всех учеников; 3/8 = 15/40 — доля выпускников среди играющих; 4/15 = 40/150.

items.stem: A lock code has 3 digits, and each digit can be any digit from 0 through 9. Digits may repeat. If a code is chosen at random, what is the probability that the code is 777?
items.explanation: Всего 10 · 10 · 10 = 1000 кодов, подходит один (A). 1/720 — без повторов цифр; 1/30 — сложили 10 + 10 + 10.

items.stem: A box contains 50 light bulbs, and 5 of them are defective. Two bulbs are chosen at random with replacement. What is the probability that both bulbs are defective?
items.explanation: С возвращением вероятность каждый раз 5/50 = 1/10; обе — 1/100.

items.stem: Events A and B are independent, with P(A) = 0.5 and P(B) = 0.4. What is P(A and B)?
items.explanation: Для независимых событий вероятности перемножаются: 0.5 · 0.4 = 0.2 (B). 0.9 — сложили; 0.45 — среднее; 0.1 — разность.

items.stem: In a random sample of 300 residents of a town, 180 said they support a new park. The town has 2,500 residents. Based on the sample, about how many residents would be expected to support the park?
A student guesses the answers to 2 true-or-false questions. What is the probability that the student answers both questions correctly?
items.explanation: Каждый ответ угадывается с вероятностью 1/2, оба — 1/2 · 1/2 = 1/4.

items.stem: A bag contains only red, blue, and green marbles in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. If one marble is chosen at random, what is the probability that it is not green?
items.explanation: Не зелёные — 2 + 3 = 5 частей из 10: 1/2 (C). 1/5 — только красные; 3/10 — только синие; 7/10 — это синие и зелёные вместе, то есть «не красный».

items.stem: The probability of rain on Saturday is 0.4. If it rains, the probability that a game is canceled is 0.75; if it does not rain, the probability that the game is canceled is 0.1. What is the probability that the game is canceled?
items.explanation: 0.4 · 0.75 + 0.6 · 0.1 = 0.30 + 0.06 = 0.36 (A). 0.85 — сложили условные вероятности; 0.75 — только при дожде; 0.4 — вероятность дождя.

items.stem: Of 80 cars in a parking lot, 30 are red, and 12 of the red cars are SUVs. Of the 50 cars that are not red, 20 are SUVs. If an SUV in the lot is chosen at random, what is the probability that it is red?
items.explanation: Внедорожников 12 + 20 = 32, красных среди них 12: 12/32 = 3/8. 12/30 — обратная условная вероятность.

items.stem: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum of the two numbers is 7?
items.explanation: Пары (1,6), (2,5), (3,4), (4,3), (5,2), (6,1) — 6 из 36, это 1/6 (B). 1/12 — посчитали пары без учёта порядка; 7/36 — «сумма 7, значит 7 исходов».

items.stem: Two students are chosen at random from a group of 5 boys and 4 girls. What is the probability that both students chosen are girls?
items.explanation: Без возвращения: 4/9 · 3/8 = 12/72 = 1/6 (A). 16/81 — с возвращением; 4/9 — только первый выбор; 2/9 — ошибка во втором множителе.

items.stem: A survey of 400 voters recorded each voter's age group and preferred candidate. Under 30: 60 prefer A and 40 prefer B. Ages 30 to 60: 90 prefer A and 110 prefer B. Over 60: 70 prefer A and 30 prefer B. If a voter who prefers candidate B is chosen at random, what is the probability that the voter is under 30?
items.explanation: За B 40 + 110 + 30 = 180 человек, из них младше 30 — 40: 40/180 = 2/9. 40/100 — обратная условная вероятность.

items.stem: A quiz has 3 questions, and each question has 4 answer choices, exactly one of which is correct. A student guesses on all 3 questions. What is the probability that the student answers at least one question correctly?
items.explanation: Удобнее через противоположное событие: все неверно — (3/4)³ = 27/64, значит хотя бы один верный — 1 − 27/64 = 37/64 (A). 27/64 — как раз «ни одного»; 3/4 — сложили 1/4 три раза; 1/64 — все верно.

items.stem: For events A and B, P(A) = 0.6, P(B) = 0.5, and P(A or B) = 0.8. What is P(A and B)?
items.explanation: P(A и B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A или B) = 1.1 − 0.8 = 0.3 (B). 1.1 — сумма без вычитания (больше 1 быть не может); 0.5 и 0.1 — ошибки.

items.stem: A jar contains x red marbles and 12 blue marbles and no other marbles. The probability of drawing a red marble at random is 0.4. What is the value of x?

Of the people in a population, 2% have a certain condition. A test detects the condition in 90% of people who have it and gives a positive result for 5% of people who do not have it. If a randomly chosen person tests positive, which of the following is closest to the probability that the person has the condition?
items.explanation: Из 10 000 человек: больных 200, из них положительных 180; здоровых 9800, ложноположительных 490. P = 180/670 ≈ 0.27 (B). 0.90 — вероятность положительного теста у больного, обратное условие; 0.95 — специфичность.

items.stem: For events A and B, P(A) = 0.3, the probability of B given A is 0.5, and the probability of B given not A is 0.2. What is the probability of A given B?
items.explanation: P(A и B) = 0.15, P(не A и B) = 0.7 · 0.2 = 0.14, P(B) = 0.29. P(A | B) = 0.15/0.29 = 15/29 (C). 0.15 и 0.29 — числитель и знаменатель по отдельности; 0.5 — P(B | A).

items.stem: A spinner has 4 equal sections labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4. The spinner is spun twice. What is the probability that the product of the two numbers is even?
items.explanation: Произведение нечётное, только если оба числа нечётные: (2/4)² = 1/4. Значит, чётное — 3/4.

items.stem: A committee of 2 people is chosen at random from 6 people: A, B, C, D, E, and F. What is the probability that person A is on the committee?
items.explanation: Всего пар C(6, 2) = 15, пар с A — 5 (A с каждым из остальных): 5/15 = 1/3 (C). 1/6 — как будто выбирают одного; 1/5 — одна конкретная пара из пяти.

items.stem: At a school of 500 students, 220 students are in a club. Of the students in a club, 130 are girls. Of the 280 students not in a club, 120 are girls. If a girl at the school is chosen at random, what is the probability that she is in a club?
items.explanation: Девочек 250, в клубах 130: 130/250 = 0.52 (C). 0.59 = 130/220 — доля девочек среди членов клуба; 0.44 — доля клуба среди всех; 0.26 = 130/500.

items.stem: In a game, a player wins $10 with probability 0.2 and loses $3 otherwise. What is the expected value, in dollars, of the player's winnings for one game?
items.explanation: 0.2 · 10 + 0.8 · (−3) = 2 − 2.4 = −0.4 доллара: в среднем игра убыточна.

items.stem: A box contains 3 white balls and 2 black balls. Balls are drawn at random one at a time without replacement until a black ball is drawn. What is the probability that the first black ball drawn is the third ball drawn?
items.explanation: Нужна последовательность белый, белый, чёрный: 3/5 · 2/4 · 2/3 = 1/5 (A). 2/5 — вероятность чёрного первым; 3/10 — первые два белые без третьего множителя.

items.stem: Events A and B are independent, with P(A) = 0.25 and P(B) = 0.6. What is the probability that neither A nor B occurs?
items.explanation: Противоположные события тоже независимы: 0.75 · 0.4 = 0.3 (B). 0.15 — P(A и B); 0.7 — P(A или B); 0.45 — ошибка.

items.stem: A fair coin is flipped 4 times. What is the probability of getting exactly 2 heads?
items.explanation: Всего 2⁴ = 16 исходов, с ровно двумя орлами C(4, 2) = 6: 6/16 = 3/8.

items.stem: Ana makes each free throw with probability 0.7, independently of her other attempts. What is the probability that she makes exactly one of her next two free throws?
items.explanation: Попадание-промах или промах-попадание: 2 · 0.7 · 0.3 = 0.42 (B). 0.21 — учли только один порядок; 0.49 — оба броска точные; 0.7 — один бросок.
